Use conventional commit format with a subject, empty line and a description.

- Keep subject line under 50 characters.
- Limit any line to 72 characters or less.
- Be concise and clear – avoid overly detailed explanations.

Here's the structure of the commit message:

```
type: subject

Description.
```

Examples:

feat: add two-factor authentication
fix: correct button hover effect
refactor: optimize database queries
style: update button styles
docs: update API documentation
test: add unit tests for login module
chore: update dependencies
perf: improve image loading performance
ci: add automated deployment workflow
build: update Flatpak configuration
